p1: This song was for the sons of Korah, a singing family. It begins, “Heavenly Father is our safe place and our strength.”
He is “a very present help in trouble,” always near. So the song says, “We will not fear.”
Then the Lord says, “Be still, and know that I am God.” That means get quiet and calm inside.
p2: Why be still? When we rush and worry, it is hard to feel Him near. When we are quiet, we feel His peace. Later, Jesus was in a boat in a big storm. He told the wind and sea, “Peace, be still.” And all was calm.
Tonight, lie very still and breathe slowly. Heavenly Father is your safe place, and He is near.
old: Sometimes life feels loud and busy and fast. There’s a special song for those times that says, “Be still, and know that Heavenly Father is with you.”
Being still means slowing our bodies down and making our hearts quiet and calm.

When we get very still, we can feel Heavenly Father close, like a warm, peaceful hug for our hearts. Heavenly Father is our safe place. When everything feels too fast or too big, we can be still, take a breath, and remember He is right here with us. In the quiet, we find His peace.
